title: Ukraine Wants Security Guarantees. In 1994 It Gave Up Nukes for a Promise #shorts
description:
This week Russia and Ukraine meet in Abu Dhabi to negotiate Ukraine's security after the war. In 1994, Ukraine held the world's third-largest nuclear arsenal and gave it up for the Budapest Memorandum: a promise from the United States, Britain and Russia to respect its borders.
